timing_scope: All generator stages and required candidate internal substeps included; report device-resident and host-input/output scopes separately. Divide total block time by published K, never by candidate internal substeps. One-time setup and graph capture reported separately.
scaling_limitations: These four shapes have different forcing groups and sometimes different1/8substep configurations. They are development measurements, not the registered matched-aspect scaling study.
